Options: 
A. The proceedings are conducted in secret.
B. The proceedings are conducted by a judge.
C. The defendant has a right to present evidence.
D. There is a right to Miranda warnings.
E. The proceedings are open to the public.
F. There is no right to have evidence excluded.
G. The jury's decision must be unanimous.
H. There is no right to counsel.
I. The jury is made up of 12 people.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
